quotes: A limited-validity passport using endorsement 46 should be issued when the medical circumstance that requires eyeglasses is temporary and the applicant has urgent or emergency travel.
The applicant’s expression should be natural.

unit_judgments.rationale: Covered by the first clause of C0023.
quotes: Normal, unexaggerated smiles are acceptable

unit_judgments.rationale: Covered by the second clause of C0023.
quotes: unusual expressions and squinting are not.

unit_judgments.rationale: The informational statement regarding applicants with disabilities being unable to produce natural expressions is incorporated only as background scope in C0024 and lacks a standalone claim.
quotes: Applicants with physical or mental disabilities, including loss of muscle control (e.g., age-related degeneration or because of a medical condition such as Bell's Palsy), may not be able to produce a natural or unexaggerated expression.
You may accept a photograph without a natural or unexaggerated expression in these circumstances.
Both of the applicant’s eyes should also be visible and open in the photograph (see the exception for infants in 8 FAM 402.1-1).
If the applicant is unable to open one or both eyes because of a medical condition, you may accept the photograph.

In rare cases, if it is unlikely that the closed eye(s) or exaggerated expression are because of a medical condition, you should request a medical statement signed by a medical professional/health practitioner.

Processing and communications/customer service personnel at passport agencies/centers or consular section personnel should refer applications without photographs to their supervisor for guidance on processing passport applications received without photographs;
You must not accept a form DS-11 or form DS-82 received without a photograph at the public counter.
Passport specialists must suspend a form DS-11 received without a photograph from an acceptance facility.
The applicant must re-execute the form DS-11 (see IRL 975-04);
Passport specialists must suspend a form DS-82 or form DS-5504 received without a photograph (see IRL 1000-05 and IRL 1018-14).
